title: Floating WhatsApp Customer Support Button

requirements.text: Create a FloatingWhatsApp component as a fixed circular button in the bottom-right corner of the page. The button must use WhatsApp green (#25D366) background with a white WhatsApp SVG icon inside. On click, it opens a new tab to 'https://wa.me/919819187188?text=Hello%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20know%20more%20about%20your%20Ayurvedic%20face%20packs.' The button should be 56×56px on desktop and 48×48px on mobile, positioned at bottom-right with enough margin to avoid overlapping footer or important content.

quotes: Place the WhatsApp icon as a floating button on the bottom right corner of the website.
Use a circular button with WhatsApp green color (#25D366) and a white WhatsApp icon inside.
When clicked, it should open WhatsApp chat with this number: https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX

acceptanceCriteria: Button is fixed to the bottom-right corner on both mobile and desktop viewports
Button background is #25D366 with a white WhatsApp icon
Clicking the button opens https://wa.me/919819187188 with the pre-filled message in a new tab
Button does not overlap footer or other critical content

requirements.text: Add a soft box-shadow to the FloatingWhatsApp button and a smooth hover animation: on hover, the button scales up slightly (e.g., scale-110) and gains a subtle green glow effect. A tooltip with the text 'Chat with us on WhatsApp' should appear above the button on hover, styled in earthy/natural tones consistent with the Ayurvedic palette.

quotes: Add a soft shadow and smooth hover animation (slight zoom or glow effect).
Add a small tooltip text on hover: 'Chat with us on WhatsApp'

acceptanceCriteria: Button displays a soft box-shadow in its default state
Hovering the button triggers a scale-up and green glow transition
A tooltip reading 'Chat with us on WhatsApp' appears above the button on hover
Tooltip styling matches the site's natural/earthy color palette

requirements.text: Add an entrance animation to the FloatingWhatsApp button so it fades in and slides up from the bottom when the page first loads. Use a CSS keyframe or Tailwind animation (e.g., fade-in + translate-y) with a short delay (300–500ms) so it does not distract from initial page content.

quotes: Add a subtle entrance animation (fade-in or slide-up when page loads)

acceptanceCriteria: On page load, the button animates in with a fade-in and upward slide
The entrance animation plays once and completes within 600ms
The animation does not cause layout shift or overlap other elements during entry

requirements.text: Mount the FloatingWhatsApp component inside the CustomerLayout wrapper in App.tsx so it appears on all customer-facing pages. The component should read the WhatsApp number from the backend site settings (via the existing useWhatsAppNumber or site settings React Query hook) and only render when a valid number is configured. Use the hardcoded number '919819187188' as the fallback default if the backend returns an empty string.

quotes: The button should be visible on both mobile and desktop devices.

acceptanceCriteria: FloatingWhatsApp renders on all customer-facing pages via CustomerLayout
If the backend returns a WhatsApp number, it is used in the wa.me link
If the backend returns an empty string, the fallback number 919819187188 is used
The button does not render if no number is available at all

constraints: Phone number for WhatsApp link must be 919819187188 (India country code + number)
Pre-filled message must be: 'Hello, I would like to know more about your Ayurvedic face packs.'
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Do not add any backend changes for this feature
Do not add a WhatsApp chat widget or embedded chat window — only a button linking to wa.me
Do not modify admin settings for WhatsApp number configuration (already exists)
